subject: Minor cleanup and fix typo in bzmpop get_keys_function (#3667)
reason: The change only renames BZMPOP's get_keys_function from blmpopGetKeys to bzmpopGetKeys. Both functions are identical wrappers calling genericGetKeys(0, 2, 3, 1, argv, argc, result) in src/db.c, and BZMPOP/BLMPOP share the same argument layout, so key extraction (COMMAND GETKEYS, cluster slot routing, ACL key checks) is unchanged on every input. This is a pure naming cleanup with no observable behavior change, so no scenario can distinguish the builds.
